subject: Third-party profile reconciliation & SSO provisioning
messages:
From: Ella Roberts <ella.roberts@datahub.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: DataHub Third-Party Risk <tpr@datahub.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invitation: OneTrust company portal and evidence request

Hi Stephanie / Redwood team,

Thanks again for agreeing to consolidate our vendor profile with OneTrust. We're in the middle of a portal migration and want to kick off a reconciliation so your profile mirrors what procurement & security already have on file.

Quick asks from our side to make the sync painless:
- Please accept the OneTrust portal invite I just sent (no-reply@onetrust.com).
- Upload the attached "list-of-required-evidence.xlsx" to the folder once you accept.
- Share SAML metadata or confirm whether you prefer SSO via SAML or SCIM provisioning. If SAML, I can accept your metadata file directly into our console.
- Let us know a 30-min window early next week for a short demo of how we track regressing items.

We're also able to accept an API token for automated evidence pulls if your security team prefers that—ping me if you'd rather go that route.

Attached: list-of-required-evidence.xlsx (spreadsheet with evidence checklist)

Looking forward,
Ella Roberts
Senior Third-Party Risk Analyst
DataHub Analytics

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Ella Roberts <ella.roberts@datahub.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invitation: OneTrust company portal and evidence request

Hi Ella — thanks for the clear checklist. We accepted the OneTrust invite and started a quick reconciliation pass. A few notes / next steps from our side:

1) SSO / provisioning
- We can support SAML; attaching our preliminary saml-metadata.xml for your team to ingest. If you prefer SCIM for user provisioning, we need a short runbook on scopes and a service account.

2) Evidence sync
- We'll centralize evidence on a shared Drive folder and create stable file names to avoid future drift (e.g., redwood_soc2_type2_2025.pdf). Marissa will be owner of the initial upload.

3) API access
- We are open to an API token for automated sync, but need confirmation on token expiration and minimum scopes before we enable it.

Can we do a 30-min sync on Monday Nov 1 at 10am PT? If that works for you, I'll send a calendar invite.

Attached: saml-metadata.xml (SAML metadata stub)

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invitation: OneTrust company portal and evidence request

Stephanie — copying my quick internal notes so we have an audit trail: 

- I've created the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/open?id=doc-reqs and set perms to allow DataHub access.
- Owner assignments: Marissa (SOC/Security artifacts), Kimberly (VPC/network docs), Karthik (contracting/POs).
- I'll upload the first batch (SOC2 report, encryption whitepaper, key rotation policy) by EOD Friday.

Also flagged a few items on the worksheet that are legacy (e.g., references to an old vendor ID). Will mark those as "needs reconciliation" in the spreadsheet.

On Monday's sync, I'll share screen and walk through the evidence mapping so DataHub can confirm ingestion.

Thanks —
Marissa
Sr. Security Programs Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Ella Roberts <ella.roberts@datahub.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invitation: OneTrust company portal and evidence request

Thanks, team — all good on our side. We accepted your SAML metadata and completed an initial import of the Drive artifacts you uploaded. Two quick confirmations: 

- The OneTrust portal shows your profile as "Active - synchronized" (link below).
- We used the file naming convention and mapped the SOC2 report to the "org:control:soc2" tag as expected.

We also kicked off an automated evidence pull for items we can fetch via API. Attached is a short log of that sync. Please review and let us know if any files were missed.

Portal link: https://app.onetrust.com/portal/companies/12345
DocuSign (if you need to sign the data processing addendum): https://www.docusign.net/12345

Attached: evidence_sync_log.txt
